items.text: This place is absolutely wonderful. Beautiful. I can walk everywhere. Traveling as a woman, alone I feel so safe here. Daniele is so helpful and has the best suggestions for places. She responds very quickly to questions. The best Airbnb experience I’ve ever had.

Great place but *read carefully if you’re booking for two people and would like to use both rooms*:  This place is listed as a two bedroom but the finer print insists that if you’d actually like to use the two bedrooms, you must book for *three* people. Apparently this is Airbnb policy but to me, it makes no sense: two people = two bedrooms; it shouldn’t be more complicated than that. So my friend and I, who intended on staying in separate rooms and thus thought a *two bedroom listing* would suffice, had to pay an extra £100, just to have access to what was already advertised. Admittedly, we didn’t read through all the myriad details whereupon you do, indeed, find that you must book for three, but I believe this ought to be much clearer.  Aside from all of that, it was wonderful. Luisa is an excellent host, super receptive with a flexible check-in time, and a lovely and convenient place for getting around Bologna.

This is a gem, set in a quiet street, yet 1 minutes from the fabulous restaurants and shops and all Taormina has to offer.  The property is even better than the pictures and Norma is always available to help with any recommendations or assistance.

La casa di Paula è un'ottima soluzione per soggiornare in centro a Santiago del Cile. Innanzitutto questo moderno appartamento dotato di ogni comfort è situato a pochi metri dalla fermata della metropolitana Bellas Artes e a piedi si può passeggiare per il centro e vedere tutte le attrazioni di questa città. C'è un servizio portineria 24/7 quindi molto comodo per check in e check out. L'appartamento è molto accogliente ed è completo di tutto, cucina attrezzata, bagno con doccia grande, letto comodo e biancheria casa di qualità. Paula lascia sul tavolo una scatola con le mappe per visitare Santiago e Valparaíso, ho inoltre trovato una bottiglia di vino di benvenuto e alcuni snack. Paula inoltre è sempre a disposizione per qualsiasi cosa. Io raccomando questa soluzione di alloggio e ringrazio Paula.

Bij aankomst is het even spannend om per eenpersoons lift de ruimte te bereiken maar als je eenmaal beneden aankomt weet je niet wat je ziet . De ruimte is zo mooi en een prachtige tuin erbij. We klapten de stoel uit en marloes heeft zelfs koffie voor in het apparaat achtergelaten. Wil je koffie zetten ontdek je ook een briefje dat er een taartje met verse aardbeien en slagroom voor je klaarstaat.  Ze heeft alles het tot in de puntjes verzorgd! Alles is aanwezig in het mooie appartement! 10 plus! Mijn vriendin kan nooit ergens slapen maar heeft zo heerlijk geslapen, de bedden en de topper waren heerlijk! Wil ik thuis ook;) We gaan het door vertellen aan onze vrienden maar we gaan ook terug komen! Dank voor alles, we vonden het te gek! 💋

Do stay at Reiko’s guest house! You will not need to look anywhere else. If you have never stayed at an Airbnb, this is the place for you.  Here is why… Location:  the Melrose and Fairfax area of West Hollywood has an assortment of restaurants, grocery stores, retail, and cafes.  See: Blu Jam for breakfast, and Bristol Farms for pre made food.  All within walking or short drives from Reiko’s.  Also, within a 10 minute walk, there is The Grove. This spot has upscale and outdoor shopping, which also has a farmers market attached.  The Guest House:  Reiko is detailed oriented in the best way possible. She offers all of the important amenities: space heater, first aid kit, cleaners, paper towels, washer and dryer, toiletries, bottles of water, air purifier, and a homemade guide book, etc.  The look of the Guest House is inviting, as it presents a warm and minimalist atmosphere. The outdoor area is cute and charming as well, and you will definitely want to sit outside. Overall, the guest house is in a safe, energetic, and eclectic neighborhood!  Communication:  Reiko typically responds within the hour with any answers that her guests may have. She is very accommodating and goes out of h

Had my brother in law and nephew in town - we live in Venice and needed a place for them. So happy we found Mini-Me. was so charming and quaint -  They loved the outdoor shower and all the windows. I will put any of my family there anytime!

Staying here really made my trip enjoyable. The space is clean and thoughtfully stocked. I had amazing sleep every night, and enjoyed nearby activities since this is located right next to good restaurants, coffee shops, and shopping. Check-in was smooth and the building is nice. Neighborhood felt safe at night, and day. I’d love to come back when I visit Vancouver again.

From the minute we arrived at the office to check in, the team at Living4Malaga were super helpful. The apartment is around 10min walk from the office and was easy to find. Only warning is that the lift only goes to level 7, but it is only 10-15 steps to the 8th floor. Location - AMAZING! Everything is so close and you can be at all the main attractions in 5-10 minutes. Rooms - spacious, clean. Only consideration is that the toilet is in one of the bedrooms but it didn’t bother us too much. Two double beds, full sized fridge, spacious wardrobes. We couldn’t rate it enough. Then there were the VIEWS!!  On the roof of the building, the Marina view was beautiful but our favourite was the terrace with city views, a sun trap and perfect spot for sunsets. Thank you living4malaga for all of your help. We will definitely be recommending!

A Demetria é uma pessoa espetacular! Trabalha muuuuuito e dá pra ver como é empenhada em tudo o que faz. Sempre se mostrou acessível e nas mínimas coisas que pedimos ou apenas comentamos, lá foi ela ajudar de alguma forma. Creio que a estadia, para mim e minha esposa, pode se resumir como a de ter ido passar alguns dias na casa de um parente. Algo como: minha irmã mora nos Estados Unidos e fui ficar na casa dela. Afinal, o quarto/apartamento, embora com dois banheiros, cozinha, sofá, etc, e acesso individual e exclusivo, fica no piso de baixo da casa da Demetria. Isto permitiu que ela fizesse algo impensável: diariamente servia um fartíssimo café da manhã para nós! Imagine você, toda a manhã, ao abrir a porta do quarto que dá para o pequeno hall do lado de fora, encontrar frutas, café, leite, waffles, ovos, bacon, sucos, cupcakes, etc. Nessa hora geralmente conversávamos com ela, que sempre solícita, perguntava se queríamos algo especial. Seus dois filhos super educados, eram muito queridos. O Brooklyn, onde já havíamos ficado antes, é tranquilo e muito agradável, por isso fizemos questão de voltar. Seguro, tem próximo à casa dela vários mercados, inclusive um que vende tudo a 1 dó
Allan's apartment is great.  It is beautifully decorated and cozy.  The beds are super comfortable.  We came to Vegas for a trade show.  It's a 15 min drive to the strip.  Perfect.
we are so glad to choose this acommodation.we enjoy clean and comfortable room, good kitchen equipment and wonderfull vieuw on the lake. Gerard is great host and we liked to talk with him.

I guess even though January can be an off season for the beach, compared to summer, but especially because of COVID this was an amazing retreat. The common area outdoors has seating and BBQ's and just a beautiful garden. The view of the ocean from the living room and park. Bring bikes, roller blades or just go for walks. Getting on the water so affordable. There is enough public parking and if you have to pay it's cheap. You can drive or walk to food. 2nd street is bustling. Kayaking is $12 for an hour in a bay minutes drive away. Lots of public parks. Ideal location. The home is historic and has that charm with modern.

Patrick has been a good host, always attentive to the time of our arrival and departure. Our return flight was in the afternoon, and we were able to dispose of the apartment beyond the scheduled departure time. The apartment is very well located, in a nice neighborhood, in front of a cozy boardwalk. It has a metro station in front and 5 minutes walk is the subway and train station "Nation" from which, we could go directly to Disneyland by train in 35 minutes......very important when we go with little girls. There are several types of supermarkets near the apartment, cafes, restaurants, pharmacies ... It is important to note that there is a printer where you can connect my computer or phone via wifi, to print the bus service tickets "OpenTour Paris", necessary if you do not want to go to the central offices, which are far away. Fully recommended accommodation. Pedro & Family    ;-) Canary Island. Spain

Great flat in a very convenient location. We liked staying in New Town for the pubs and restaurants. Lots of places right at your doorstep. Walking to Old Town was an uphill but short walk. There was some street noise at night due to patrons walking home from pubs but the bedrooms are at the back so it didn’t bother us. We didn’t use the sofa bed but the two king beds were very comfortable. Would highly recommend to anyone wanting a good central location to explore Edinburgh.

Ik ben heel enthousiast over dit appartement, o.a. om de volgende redenen: het is goed te bereiken met de metro (wel een eindje lopen), je hebt het grote winkelcentrum Riem Arcaden vlakbij, je zit in een rustige buurt, je hebt met de keuken, de badkamer en de slaapkamer alles wat je nodig hebt, aankomst en vertrek zijn gemakkelijk. Alleen als je een huiskamer met bank etc. zou willen hebben ben je hier niet aan het juiste adres. Het was voor mij echt een tijdelijk thuis ver van huis. En Annette reageerde altijd supersnel.

This place was perfect! Jean-Pierre was very helpful with getting us set up. The apartment is in an amazing location - close to tons of great bars, restaurants, coffee shops, and very easy to get to the Metro if you plan on taking public transit. This was our first time visiting Paris, and this place was a big part of what made it so great. Can’t wait to come back!

Josh is the best host! When we checked in he ran through some things with us that we could do and then followed up on idea via email while we were there. The location of the house is great for those without a car - the bus runs from the end of the street down into San Francisco and the piers. We did loads while we stayed and enjoyed our time there. The room is lovely, bed is super comfy and the sunshine flooded in in the morning (if you sleep lightly, use an eye mask!) the area is safe too. Overall, it was great and we really hope to go back.

These hosts deserve a perfect score! We had an excellent experience with them. They are very welcoming, accommodating and responsive. The dog was such a joy ! This place is very clean and very confortable, with all suitable amenities for travellers. The neighbourhood is also great, with all services nearby (parking lot, pharmacy, restaurants, stores). I even discovered my new favourite Indian restaurant! I highly recommend this place.

This is our 4th. time to Gracia area, and this appartment i cool and well placed. It is clean and comfortable, clear that this is not a home, but used for rental. Could use some cushions for the outdoor furniture and think that two rolls of toilet paper for 8 days is a bit low. We did ask the agent for more at our arrival and got a few more rolls. Great terrace. Can highly recommend the Forn Goya bakery, such nice ladies, and we left our suitcases there after check out until we left for the airport. Gracia is a wonderfull area and we will come back again.

Ritsa is all you can ask for in a host and more. A great hotel, excellent location close to the beach and bus stops for access to Fira and other parts of Santorini. Be sure to check out the boat tours too.
Lovely little place with a fairly spacious living area and a nice little garden. Was well equipped to handle two couples and has everything you need for a relaxing stay.

it was a great experience to have the chance to stay at barbara and athena's. Cosy and well furnished, it felt really at home. The shelves and fridge were well stocked with necessities and breakfast stuff. Clean room and toilets, and a private porch ! Location was a 10 min drive to the strip and it was convenient by car. lots of eateries and groceries nearby, a 99 cents store which was essential. The pool was great, and so was the bbq pit. Appreciated that she waited to greet us in when we came pretty late in the evening, and she even did the laundry for us ! what a great gesture i feel and how warm she was, checking up on us from time to time. I recommend a stay here at the bird bath !

I had a fantastic stay at Aaron's place. The location was perfect, just a 15-minute walk to the beach, and the neighborhood was nice and quiet 😊 The check-in process was easy, and I appreciated how clean everything was 👌🏼 What really stood out, though, was the excellent communication with both Aaron and Ana. They always responded quickly, were super friendly, and incredibly helpful throughout my stay.  Thank you, Aaron and Ana!
Rima was a fantastic host and I loved it at her place. She was flexible with check in and always very quick at answering any questions.

Great location with lots of restaurants and shopping nearby. It is definitely a very small space and we found that the pictures did not match our studio apartment (I think there are several units in the building that they rent out). But it was clean and comfortable!

We highly enjoyed our stay at Hahn's place in Melbourne. The apartment is small, but confortable and very clean and tastefully decorated. It has everything it is described and works to perfection! The wash and dryer (it's one machine with both functions) is inside the apartment and wonderfully convenient, as you can leave a load of clothes washing and go out. It's relatively quiet as well (we slept through the drying cycle - though it is audiable, it's definitely not loud).  The apartment also offered a stove, a mini-freezer and a microwave, ironing table for clothes, cutlery, etc. Shampoo, conditioner and bath gel were provided. The location was perfect, in the very center of the Melbourne CBD, it is impossible to think of a better place to get around. It was also quiet in the night.  The apartment was a little bit warm because of the hot weather days we got in Melbourne, but this was a very small nuisance compared to the great features this flat offers. Hahn was a very attentive host, who received us with fresh fruit and earlier than expected. Those little kindness gestures warmed our hearts and made a great start to a wonderful stay at Melbourne. I would recommend Hahn's place a

This is a great location for a stay in Amsterdam.  Quiet residential area, and easy walking distance to a grocery store and tram stop.  Our only problem was walking there from the train station; if we did it again we would take a cab.  The streets are challenging because of the canals and bridges.  Fortunately the local people were incredibly helpful in helping us find our way. The apartment is very comfortable and well equipped.  We would definitely stay there again if we were to return to Amsterdam.

An updated space in a beautiful old neighbourhood within easy walking distance to delicious markets and restaurants, and close to popular tourist attractions. The proximity to a large play park and outdoor pool was a definite plus for our active pre-teen kids.  Immaculately clean and well-maintained with very agreeable hosts. We couldn’t ask for more!

Die vier Tage im Appartement von Emanuele in Mailand vergingen wie im Flug. Ganz maßgeblich daran beteiligt war das Gefühl, stets "zu Hause" zu sein. War es auch eine "fremde" Stadt mit vielen neuen Eindrücken, so hat Emanuele dafür gesorgt, dass ich mich von Anfang an wohl gefühlt habe.   Ganz wichtig: Emanuele spricht Englisch! :-) Das mag als Hinweis merkwürdig erscheinen. Wer aber schon in Italien war, weiß das sehr zu schätzen. Und wer noch nicht dort war, wird schnell erkennen, dass das nicht selbstverständlich ist...  Am Ankunftstag hat er bis spät abends vor Ort gewartet, bis ich dann endlich von meinem verspäteten Flug eintraf. Er begrüßte mich mit der selben herzlichen Art, mit der er auch während der Tage, die ich in Mailand war, stets bei Fragen zur Verfügung stand. Ob es die Suche nach einer guten Bar, nach einem guten Wein, nach Restaurants oder auch die Frage nach anderen Tipps für den Aufenthalt war...  Auch das Appartement ermöglichte ein schnelles Wohlfühlen. Das kleine Häuschen liegt im Innenhof eines Mehrfamilienhauses. Es hat alles, was man benötigt, um wirklich entspannen zu können. (Natürlich sind die TV-Programme italienisch. Wer also andere benötigt,
Very sunshine and clear room. David is very friendly and generuous. No doubt, it's one of the best place I've ever lived.

This was a great place located 2 blocks from the beach and just a few short minutes from Hilo town shops and restaurants, scenic drive, and the Rainbow and Akake falls.  The place was sparkling clean , beds we're very comfy, and the original and local island decor gave a nice ambiance for a relaxing beach weekend.  Our host was polite and got back to us immediately during booking and check-out.  This will certainly be our go-to spot when we come back to Hilo!

Wir waren im Juni 2013 in Siracusa und haben in Lilia´s house 2 übernachtet. Das Apartment ist ganz neu und hochwertig eingerichtet,mit vielen liebevollen Details. Es ist alles da, was man brauchen könnte. Die Wohnung war sehr sauber.Wir sind relativ spät abends angekommen und fanden es sehr schon, dass Marco schon für uns eine Flasche leckeren sizilianischen Rotwein hingestellt hatte & Saft, Milch und Kaffee für den nächsten morgen.Die Lage ist sehr gut, wir konnten direkt vor der Tür kostenlos parken. Die Strasse ist groß und deswegen relativ laut, aber dafür ist man für weniger als 10 min. zu Fuss in der Altstadt( Ortigia). Marco ist sehr bemüht, dass sich die Gäste gut fühlen und den nichts fehlt.Wir sind sehr zufrieden und können diese Unterkunft nur weiterempfehlen:)))       We had a great time in Lilia´s house 2!The apartment is very nice furnished with a lot of small beautiful details. It was very clean!Marco is very friendly. The old town of Siracusa is just in 10 min. walk from the house. We could park just in front of the apartment for free. We are very satisfied and we absolutely recommend Lilia´s house!:)
Wohnung in toller Lage direkt am Strand, schöne Dachterrasse, kostenloses Parken in unmittelbarer Nähe,nette Gastgeberin

This is a wonderful apartment that feels like a treehouse overlooking Parque México. It was spotless and beautifully decorated and appointed. At first I wasn't sure if I would mind going through the cafe and climbing a few flights of stairs to get to the accommodation but after a day it felt perfectly comfortable. The cleaners came daily and were completely inconspicuous yet left the place pristine. The location couldn't be better - Hippodroma is the place to be. A delicious breakfast of croissant, fruit plate and coffee in Cafe Toscana was a wonderful way to start each day. Alejandra was lovely to interact with, and couldn't have been more helpful and responsive to my questions. I hope to return!

Wir haben 6 Nächte in der wunderschönen Unterkunft von Roberto verbracht. Da unser Flug sehr früh war, konnten wir vor 15 Uhr einchecken, ohne einen Aufpreis zu zahlen. Roberto war mit uns in Kontakt und empfing uns sehr herzlich in der Unterkunft. Die Unterkunft ist exakt wie auf den Bildern gezeigt, sehr sauber, wunderschön und modern eingerichtet, es fehlte uns an nichts! Wir haben uns von Anfang an wie zuhause gefühlt. Roberto gab uns hilfreiche Tipps was wir in Pigneto unternehmen können und auch wie wir ins Zentrum gelangen. Pigneto ist ein sehr schöner kleiner Stadtteil mit tollen Bars und Cafés und einem Supermarkt direkt um die Ecke. Ich würde jedem raten, in Erwägung zu ziehen nicht direkt im Zentrum sondern nach Pigneto zu übernachten. Man ist trotzdem sehr schnell im Zentrum (ca 25 Minuten mit Metro oder Bus) und bei allen wichtigen Spots. Vielen Dank an Roberto und Debora für eure Gastfreundschaft, wir kommen wieder!

We absolutely loved staying here. The home is incredibly cozy and neat. We loved that it was quiet throughout the day and night. Although, as others have mentioned the place does share a wall with the neighbors next door and you can hear conversations etc. We didn’t have issues though and neighbors were incredibly respectful. We loved that Daniela was so easy to communicate with. She had clear check in directions and responded quickly to any questions we had. The home is very close to the beach (walking distance) and you can pretty much find anything within a few miles. We would totally recommend this place to anyone who is staying in Santa Cruz and it is a place we would book in the future as well

Just back from a fantastic 2 night stay at Vanessa's place. Vanessa met us at the water bus stop and it was about a 5min walk from there. The apartment was bigger than expected, with lovely big rooms, furnished & equiped beautifully. The aircon, WiFi & Sky TV was particularly loved by our teenage kids! The location was FANTASTIC. Right in the middle of the old city. There was a supermarket & bank on the doorstop and cafes & restaurants surrounding us. We ate out one night & cooked in the other - everything we needed was in the kitchen. Vanessa was great at communication, with pretty good English and was very informative and kind. We would recommend this apartment & would definitely return!
Perfect communication and instructions. The flat is a perfect base for a visit of downtown. You can park in the street and Brett gutes you a voucher.

Elevator, ( that’s is very, very, important ). Not only is the place AMAZING!!!  It is in the middle of Valencia. Safe neighborhood, waking distance to shopping, sites, and the best restaurant.  We loved it!!! I surprised my mother for her 65 th birthday, they bought her flowers. Touch my heart. Best AIRBNB yet.
Everything fine! Very central location, we visited most places by walking! Good tips and very nice host!

Our hosts were great, and they provided everything we needed, including fast responses.  Their location, close to several retail spots and the airport, was choice.  We were able to get supplies quickly and get to exploring.  Very convenient for the big Island, though several places to visit did thereafter require significant driving.  But, that also allowed us to see more of the island, so win-win.  Very nice folks, highly recommended.

I LOVE this house! This bungalow was exactly what I was looking for. Chris & Kosha are excellent communicators and were accommodating to anything I needed. The checkin-checkout process was a piece of cake. The house, furniture, and artwork is all so fun! Also, it's so close to all of the wonderful things that Austin has to offer. I am an Austin native and this was the perfect place for an in-town staycation.  Chris & Kosha - Thank you for sharing your place with me. It was a very special time.
Great place to stay with family and friends, they offered more than we spected. Great location  Host very accessible to are questions.
Awesome location, super clean and comfortable apartment. The sofa bed is the most comfortable I have ever slept on! Highly recommend staying here.

Very inviting architect-designed apartment in a very cool neighbourhood, with everything done by the host to make you feel immediately at home in Seville. Very good value, very fun stay, would recommend! Also, we stayed in November and it was bright, sunny and warm.

We stayed in ANTICHI ULIVI for 6 days. The place was amazing: spotlessly clean with a wonderful interior. The rooms are very spacey, the kitchen has everything you need. It was a nice 15 minutes walk to the beach, which was very pleasant for April weather.  There is a private back garden with comfortable sits and lots of wonderful plants around. We also met a very friendly cat Mia in the garden  🐈‍⬛. Renata was very helpful, she organised us a transfer whenever we needed, advised us few places to visit around Mondello. Great holiday,  ANTICHI ULIVI is highly recommended.

Very good located and quiet apartment close to the Marais, Notre Dame, the Seine. Sorounded by lot’s of Shops and restaurants and very good bakerys. Charlotte‘s help and response was very good. We liked it a lot. We would come back.

El apartamento tiene detalles de gran estilo, que ni en un hotel encontrarías. Excelente ambientación, todo el departamento con detalles de categoría, la zona estupenda cerca de mercados y a 100 metros de Copacabana, seguridad las 24 hs. Toallas de algodón egipcio, cada artefacto funcionaba a la perfección,  nos sentimos  tal vez mejor que en casa. Fátima es una anfitriona estupenda, siempre atenta a cada detalle e interesada en que nuestra estadía sea totalmente placentera. Sin lugar a dudas, sobresaliente en todo sentido. Volveremos!!! Gracias!

Endless horizon was an amazing stay, can’t express how much we enjoyed it. Our host arranged our pick up from the airport, and our drop off at the ferry when we left. He set up a site seeing tour that took us all over the island, highly recommend the tour. The driver was one of the nicest people in Greece. The village of Stegna is beautiful with a quiet beach, and a variety of restaurants to choose from. Stegna Kozas is a must. Stegna is in a great location for day trips to Butterfly Valley, Old Town, and Lindos. Tsambika Beach is one of the nicest beaches and only about 10min away. Endless Horizon sits atop of a hill that overlooks Stegna beach, the property is like new. The pictures are breathtaking, but the in-person view is even better. Prepare to walk a large hill, renting a scooter or vehicle is helpful. Ended most nights laying on the bed outside, listening to the ocean and music playing in the village. Everything you’d want in a vacation to Rhodes. 5 stars isn’t enough!
